label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
Dear Neighbors,

I'm Jess Okafor in 5A. Many of you have seen the note posted in the lobby about a drone flying from the roof deck. That was me, and I'd like to explain what happened.

On Saturday, October 31, around 4 p.m., I flew a new drone from the roof deck for about 11 minutes. I'm a wedding photographer, and I was testing the equipment before a vineyard wedding in Dundee. The camera was pointed west the entire time, toward the river and the Fremont Bridge. At no point was it aimed at anyone's windows or units.

I also understand how it looked. A buzzing object hovering over the courtyard is unsettling if you don't know what it is or who's flying it, and I've heard that some children in the building were frightened by it. I'm sorry for the worry it caused. I should have let people know ahead of time.

If you'd like to see exactly what I recorded, I'm happy to show anyone the full, unedited footage. You can knock on my door at 5A or email me at jess.okafor@mailbox.example, and we'll find a time.

Our HOA rules don't currently address drones. I'll ask the board to put the topic on the agenda for the November 19 meeting (7 p.m. in the community room) so we can agree on a clear rule together. Until the board makes a decision, I won't fly from the roof.

I do want to say, as calmly as I can, that the lobby note was hard to read. Being called a creep in a shared space, with my unit number attached, felt very public and very personal, especially after three years of living here. If something I do concerns you in the future, I'd much rather you come talk to me directly. I promise I'll listen.

Thank you for reading this. I hope to see some of you on the 19th.

Warmly,
Jess Okafor
Unit 5A
